newsitem.title: GERMANY: German engineers Heckert could declare insolvency.
newsitem.headline: German engineers Heckert could declare insolvency.

text.p: The Chemnitz-based engineering group Heckert said on Tuesday that it would apply on Wednesday to be declared insolvent unless its liquidity could be secured in the meantime.
"If there is not money there tomorrow, then we will have to go to the courts," Heckert's managing director Peter Ulrich told Reuters on Tuesday.
The company has been experiencing difficulties since its parent company, Traub AG in Reichenbach/Fils, applied for protection from creditors.
